verdict.rationale: Solid's own README claims full SSR and serverless support and documents support for Deno and Cloudflare Worker runtimes, so its server rendering is compatible with serverless and edge targets. Nothing in the evidence shows deployment adapters, presets, or one-step deploy tooling that removes custom infrastructure setup. missing for 10: documented deployment adapters/presets for serverless/edge platforms, evidence of zero-config deployment, independent hands-on corroboration of edge deploys

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy my server-rendered app to serverless or edge runtimes without custom infrastructure setup

citations.quote: Solid has full SSR and serverless support, with streaming and progressive hydration to get to interactive as quickly as possible.
For server environments, we support Node LTS and the latest Deno and Cloudflare Worker runtimes.
